operations.title: Forced C4 branch enhancements are generically A1 nodes
operations.body: At projective infinity the correct quartic branch is 4B4=-Delta^T adj(G) Delta. Across all 296 labelled forced triple incidences, the activated branch is generically an A1 node. Normalization gives six deck-paired lines with OS ranks (1,6,5), hence mixed Tate plus quadratic Kummer coefficient data and no new carrier stratum.

operations.title: Exact audit of 296 forced C4 branch incidences
operations.body: Exact rational witnesses verify a nondegenerate restricted quadratic part for every labelled incidence record; the alternating point is universally branch singular in 144 occurrences.
